name: Traver IDC
old_description: Experts in Everything Electrical For The Industrial Marketplace
about:
Traver IDC is based in Waterbury, Connecticut. The company has served the industrial marketplace for more than 75 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The firm operates an EASA‑accredited motor repair facility and provides field‑service electrical contracting, electrical supply distribution, electrical/mechanical engineering, and energy‑conservation services. Its nearly 50 employees support a fleet of over 25 service vehicles — including pickup trucks, service vans, a box truck, and a five‑ton rack truck — enabling 24‑hour coverage for motor repair, on‑site troubleshooting, panel building, infrared testing, dynamic balancing, laser alignment, preventative maintenance, and systems integration.

Traver IDC serves customers in aerospace, medical, metal fabrication, and water/wastewater treatment facilities, as well as broader industrial plants requiring electrical apparatus repair, installation, and energy‑efficiency upgrades.

The company emphasizes its “single source” model, combining motor repair, contracting, supply, engineering, and energy audits under one roof. It also highlights utility‑rebate assistance for energy‑conservation projects and round‑the‑clock emergency response as key differentiators.
